description: Privileged system access requires multi-factor authentication and is recertified quarterly by the control owner
New user access is granted through a documented request-and-approval workflow
Personal data at rest is encrypted using an industry-standard algorithm
Personal data records are catalogued in a data inventory maintained by the privacy team
Financial statements are reviewed and signed off by the controller before publication
Journal entries above a defined threshold require a second independent approver
Vendor contracts are reviewed by legal before signature and reassessed annually
Production changes follow a documented change-management workflow with testing and approval
Security incidents are logged and investigated by the incident response team
